ignore_eos_reason: Fixed-length decode throughput workload: generate exactly the requested number of tokens in both arms, including when EOS would otherwise end the response. These are not organic completion-length measurements.
order: required 128-token off/on nmax2 for both samplers; greedy 128 sweep 1,3,5,7 (reuse nmax2); 1024 off/on nmax2 both samplers if primary healthy; secondary mainline off/on nmax5 both samplers at128; optional old drafter and 8K not required
comparison: Paired prompt, seed, length, sampler, build, target GGUF and flags; only drafter switches differ. Fresh server per arm/sampling/length setting; cache_prompt false for each request. Report three runs per prompt and cell, plus per-prompt means and aggregate equal-weight mean, never merge different builds.

additional_cells.reason: The required sweep selected nmax3; time/balance permit the user-authorized optional tests. Keep these exploratory.
